Form 2    34
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
Shanghai Municipal Police    No. 246
Date 12/4/16
Bubbling Well    Station.
April 12th    1916
REPORT ON Movements of Chinese troops.
Made by J. S. Sullivan.    Forwarded by
Sir
I respectfully beg to report that 400
soldiers armed with rifles, and 15 mules crossed
the Soochow Creek a little west of the Jessopfield
ferry at about 10.30 a.m. 11th inst.
I am informed that these are some of the
men who came to Shanghai a few days ago, and
are now being sent back north.
I beg to remain
Sir
Your Obedient Servant
J. Sullivan. Det Sgt.
The Chief Detective Inspector.

表格 2    34
刑事侦缉处
情报官登记
上海公共租界工部局警务处    第 246 号
日期 1916 年 4 月 12 日
静安寺捕房。
1916 年 4 月 12 日
关于中国军队动向的报告。
由 J. S. Sullivan 呈报。    转呈
阁下
职谨此报告，本月 11 日上午约 10 时 30 分，400 名配备步枪的士兵及 15 头骡子在杰斯菲尔德（Jessopfield）轮渡稍西侧渡过苏州河。
职获悉，这些士兵是数日前抵达上海的部分人员，现正被遣返北方。
职谨此
阁下
恭顺的仆人
J. Sullivan，侦探警长
首席侦探督察
